activities.name: If Watermark Value Used
activities.description: If it's a database source table that needs incremental ingestion or the source doesn't use a query

text.value:
SELECT  *
FROM    dbo.Data_Pipeline_Metadata_Orchestration
WHERE   Table_ID = @{pipeline().parameters.table_id}
AND     Trigger_Name = '@{pipeline().parameters.trigger_name}'

activities.name: Metadata

dependsOn.activity: Watermark and FIFO and Failure Check

activities.name: Watermark and FIFO and Failure Check
activities.description: Get metadata, and confirm there is no ingestion currently being run for the table ID, and determine if there was a failure on last run to ensure data gets written to bronze table
